entries.en: Do you want to buy {0} {1} for {2} gold coins?

entries.en: Good bye, {0}.

entries.en: Greetings, {0}.

entries.en: You do not have this object.
entries.translated: Nu aveți acest obiect.

entries.en: You do not have enough capacity for all items.
entries.translated: Nu aveți suficientă capacitate pentru toate articolele.

entries.en: Sorry, I'm not offering anything.
entries.translated: Scuze, nu ofer nimic.

entries.en: Thank you, come back whenever you're in need of something else.
entries.translated: Mulțumesc, revino ori de câte ori ai nevoie de altceva.

entries.en: Choose wisely! Or maybe you want to look only at {0}.

entries.en: Have a look. But perhaps you just want to see my {0}.

entries.en: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, {0}! I buy all kinds of loot, would you look at {1}.
entries.translated: Ah, un client! Fii salutat, {0}! Cumpăr tot felul de pradă, te uiți la {1}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at {0}.
entries.translated: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Sau vrei să te uiți doar la {0}.

entries.en: You are already promoted!
entries.translated: Ești deja promovat!

entries.en: You already possess this blessing.
entries.translated: Dețineți deja această binecuvântare.

entries.en: You need the blessing of the great geomancer first.
entries.translated: Mai întâi ai nevoie de binecuvântarea marelui geomant.

entries.en: Oh. You do not have enough money.
entries.translated: Oh. Nu ai destui bani.

entries.en: You have been blessed by one of the seven gods!
entries.translated: Ai fost binecuvântat de unul dintre cei șapte zei!

entries.en: I can only allow premium players to travel there.

entries.en: You do not have enough money!
entries.translated: Nu ai destui bani!

entries.en: Get out of there with this blood.
entries.translated: Pleacă de acolo cu acest sânge.
